description: Read messages that agents on the owner's other computers sent to this computer with jrd_message_send. Returns the unread messages, oldest first, each with the sending computer's name, its label and the time, and marks them read. Set wait_seconds to wait for a message to arrive instead of returning an empty list at once; call it again to keep waiting. Pass `after` (a message id) to read again everything newer than that id.

after.description: Return every message with an id above this one, read or not.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for a message when none is unread. 0 to 50, default 0.

name: jrd_message_read
